tldr: Mars in the 8th house: drive becomes personal through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
body:
With Mars in the 8th house, this part of you pushes through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change. Mars describes drive, anger, courage, desire, defense, and the will to act. In practice, this brings attention to what you share, owe, merge with, grieve, fear, desire, or struggle to control.

When this placement is supported, you can become more honest about trust, attachment, and what is actually shared. Mars can become courage, initiative, stamina, desire, and the ability to move when something matters.

When it is strained, control, secrecy, or fear can make closeness feel heavier than it needs to be. The harder pattern can show up as reactivity, conflict, burnout, or acting before the real target is clear.
gift: courage, initiative, stamina, desire, and the ability to move when something matters expressed through shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
challenge: reactivity, conflict, burnout, or acting before the real target is clear around shared money, intimacy, trust, debt, grief, fear, and deep change.
